name: The Missing Courier
summary: In Feathermoon Stronghold, Latronicus Moonspear seeks help after a courier vanishes. The courier and his parcels have been gone about a week, and the stronghold's searches found nothing. Latronicus has declared him missing in action and sends you to Ginro Hearthkindle.

sections.title: A Courier Gone Missing
sections.body:
Latronicus Moonspear has exhausted the stronghold's search for a courier and his parcels. Both have been missing for about a week, and Latronicus has declared the courier missing in action.

Ginro Hearthkindle, Latronicus's associate, is looking for help in Feathermoon Stronghold, perhaps in his quarters. Latronicus asks you to speak with Ginro if you have time and means to spare.

sections.title: Ginro's Weary Search
sections.body:
Ginro Hearthkindle knows Latronicus Moonspear sent you, though Ginro calls him Latro. The search seems a lost cause to Ginro, but he accepts whatever help is offered and longs to put the matter to rest.

Each day, Ginro searches Feralas for signs of Raschal. Each night, he returns with only gnoll teeth and disappointment.

faq.answer: A courier and the parcels he carried have been missing for about a week. Feathermoon Stronghold's searches found nothing, and the courier has been declared missing in action.

faq.q: Where can Ginro Hearthkindle be found?
faq.answer: Ginro Hearthkindle is in Feathermoon Stronghold, perhaps in his quarters.

faq.q: Who starts the search for the courier?
faq.answer: Latronicus Moonspear, in Feathermoon Stronghold, sends you to Ginro Hearthkindle for help.
